what: Dog Control Data From Auckland Council
title: Dog Control Data From Auckland Council
text: akldogs contains data relating dogs management Auckland. Data sourced Auckland Council’s Animal Management division via official information request (#8140017948). goal make data accessible R users. registration: raw data dog known Animal Management financial years 2021-2025. impounds: raw data impound event financial years 2022-2024. rfs: raw data request service financial years 2020-2025. locality: helper table standardise relationship suburbs, local boards, regions reported datasets provided Animal Management. Cleaned versions datasets, appear package, can also found CSV format data-raw folder.
